Quest name: Glass and Lace
Quest location: San Francisco Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Search, r17 Art, ITA(Italian)
Pre-requisite discovery: Decorated Goblet discovery (from "Glasswork from Venice" quest)
